PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Test only: pushes the test's ships as a clang drive would and writes their state
PluginData.Description: Test only. Pushes the test's "CL Push" and "CL Spike" grids beyond what their thrusters can, and writes the speed, power and thrust the server has for every "CL" grid to clang-probe.txt in the game's user data folder.
